facts.claim: Business apps convert about 66.7% of App Store page views to installs
facts.source_title: ASO Conversion Rate Benchmarks by App Category
facts.excerpt: Business category shows approximately 66.7% page view to install conversion on App Store.

facts.claim: US App Store search install medians span 2.6% to 12.4% across top-level categories, against 0.1% to 2.5% from browse
facts.source_title: ASO Conversion Rate Benchmarks by App Category
facts.excerpt: In August 2026, U.S. App Store Search medians spanned 2.6% to 12.4% across top-level categories, while Browse produced 0.1% to 2.5%.

facts.claim: The average US App Store conversion rate across categories is 8.56%, with an average install rate of 3.8%
facts.source_title: ASO Conversion Rate Benchmarks by App Category
facts.excerpt: The average conversion rate across all categories on the US App Store was 8.56%, while the average install rate across all categories was 3.8%.

facts.claim: The business category records the highest download-to-trial rate of any app category
facts.excerpt: The business app category had the highest download to trial rate out of all categories covered in the State of Subscription Apps.

facts.claim: Productivity and B2B SaaS apps hold 20% to 32% at day 30, against an average iOS app at 5.3%
facts.excerpt: For productivity and B2B SaaS apps, day-30 retention benchmarks are 20-32%. The average iOS app retention rate drops to 5.3% by day 30.

facts.claim: SaaS segments are defined by annual contract value: SMB under 10,000 dollars, mid-market 10,000 to 100,000, enterprise above 100,000
facts.source_title: B2B SaaS Churn Rate Benchmarks, 939 Companies by Segment and ACV
facts.excerpt: Segments are defined by ACV: SMB under $10K, Mid-Market $10K-$100K, Enterprise above $100K.
